title: Kuwait SO2 vs UAL returns
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Kuwait CAMS SO2 20d z-score falling below -1 tracks refinery outages that widen jet-fuel cracks (-); trade short UAL 4d at 3d lag [airquality.kuwait.cams_so2 -> finance.UAL.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: airquality.kuwait.cams_so2 rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short UAL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Null control: Kuwait CAMS SO2 20d z-score > 1 (refinery activity, not outage) should NOT predict airline ETF moves (-); trade short JETS 2d at 1d lag [airquality.kuwait.cams_so2 -> finance.JETS.log_return] (parent: R2-0071)
